title: Marketing and Communications Officer
description:
Marketing and Communications Officer

Hours of Work: Up to 37 hours per week; Some evening and weekend work may be necessary to carry out the duties of this post

Salary: £31,063 £32,094 (FTE)

Term of Employment: Fixed Term (18 months)

Location: Rotherham

The Marketing and Communications Officer will play an instrumental role in promoting all strands of the Moving Rotherham initiative and will lead on designing, delivering, and evaluating innovative marketing strategies to communicate project impact, grow audiences, and encourage active participation across diverse communities in Rotherham.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy and Brand Management:
- Devising and monitoring campaign strategies and individual project plans within defined budgets.
- Implementing an effective and engaging brand identity across all programme strands.
- Evaluating all marketing campaigns to ensure audience targets and financial targets are met.

2. Digital Communications and Content Creation:
- Managing and updating the Moving Rotherham website and digital platforms.
- Planning and creating engaging social media content across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- Producing and monitoring targeted e-newsletters.
- Supporting project documentation and evaluation commissioning film and photography.

3. Media Relations and Event Promotion:
- Serving as the key point of contact for media enquiries across local, regional, and national print, broadcast, and online media.
- Identifying opportunities with strategic networks to secure media coverage.
- Creating and implementing imaginative communications for events, festivals, and community roadshows.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration and Compliance:
- Building strong relationships with delivery partners, website providers, designers, and evaluation teams.
- Assisting members of the public via telephone and in person in a courteous manner.
- Ensuring compliance with Data Protection Act / GDPR guidelines, as well as organisational policies on Equality, Health and Safety, Corporate Image, and Confidentiality.

Voluntary Action Rotherham (VAR) is the lead body for supporting, developing and promoting the Voluntary and Community Sector (VCS) in the Rotherham Borough. Our role is to facilitate effective action to bring about positive change in the lives of individuals and communities in the local area.

To apply for this role, please send in your CV and a covering letter (outlining your skills and experience in relation to this role).

Closing date for applications is 5:00pm on Monday, 23rd of November.

Interviews are likely to be held on Friday, 4th of December at The Spectrum. We will, however, review applications as they are submitted and may bring candidates forward for an interview (with reasonable notice) at any time. We may also close this vacancy early if sufficient applications have been received.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator
Location: Rotherham
Salary: £27,000 to £30,000
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid working after training, with three days per week in the office

Elevation Recruitment Group is working with a business in Rotherham to recruit a Payroll Administrator on a temporary-to-permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for an experienced payroll professional to join an established team, take responsibility for accurate payroll processing and develop their skills within a supportive working environment.

The role offers hybrid working following training, alongside a competitive benefits package and opportunities for salary progression.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing end-to-end UK payroll, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
- Completing pre-payroll and post-payroll checks, including monthly payroll reconciliations.
- Processing statutory payments, deductions and pension contributions.
- Preparing and submitting HMRC Real Time Information returns and other statutory documentation.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and handling sensitive payroll information confidentially.
- Investigating payroll discrepancies and resolving employee queries promptly.
- Supporting the preparation of P60s, P11 Ds and other payroll-related documentation.
- Ensuring payroll activities comply with current legislation, HMRC requirements and GDPR.
- Assisting with payroll audits and maintaining high standards of data accuracy.

To be successful in this Payroll Administrator role, you will have:
- Previous experience processing UK payroll from start to finish, with minimal supervision.
- Experience using payroll software such as Sage, with the ability to learn new systems.
- A good working knowledge of HMRC submissions, RTI and pension auto-enrolment.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, sorting and filtering data, and pivot tables.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work to strict monthly deadlines.
- A professional approach to handling confidential employee information.
- Good communication skills and the ability to resolve payroll queries effectively.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,000 to £30,000.
- Temporary-to-permanent opportunity.
- Hybrid working after training
- Enhanced company sick pay.
- Pension scheme
- On-site parking

If you are an experienced payroll professional looking for your next opportunity in Rotherham, this could be an excellent fit. Apply today or contact Elevation Recruitment Group for further information.

title: Service and Validation Administrator
description:
Service & Validation Administrator

Salary: £26,500 - £28,000 per annum

Location: Rotherham

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (45 minutes lunch) onsite

A well established service focused Medical organisation is seeking a Service & Validation Administrator to support its busy service department. This is a varied administrative and coordination role, central to ensuring efficient service delivery and high standards of customer support.

The role

Working closely with the Service and Contracts teams, you will provide day to day administrative support and help maintain smooth operational processes.

Key responsibilities include:
- Collating and checking Validation and Laboratory Reports before issuing to customers
- Generating and sending service and callout reports
- Loading contracts onto the system and creating pre planned jobs and stock requirements
- Supporting the Contract Manager with renewals
- Maintaining internal tracking spreadsheets
- Assisting the coordination team during busy periods or absences
- Providing telephone support and responding to customer enquiries
- Ensuring all enquiries are logged and responded to within the same day

Person specification
- Previous experience in an administrative or coordination role is preferred
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Clear and professional written and verbal communication
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook
- Able to work collaboratively within a team
- High attention to detail and willingness to learn

This is an excellent opportunity for someone organised and proactive who enjoys working in a structured, team focused environment with a strong emphasis on customer service.

If you are interested in the role of Service and Validation Administrator and feel that you have the relevant experience, please contact your Recruitment Partner, Lisa Logan at Unicorn Resourcing.

If this job isn't exactly right for you but you're looking for something new, please contact us for a confidential career discussion.

Unicorn Resourcing Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in regard to this Permanent opportunity.

title: Medical Education Administrator
description: Are you organised, approachable and looking for a varied administrative role where you can make a real difference to the education and experience of future and current doctors? We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Band 3 (Banding is subject to job evaluation) Medical Education Administrator to join our Medical Education team, based in the Medical Education Centre. This is a busy and varied role providing administrative support to the Medical Undergraduate Team and wider Medical Education Team. You will help coordinate education and training for medical students, resident doctors and other learners, including teaching programmes, placements, inductions, examinations and educational events. As a key point of contact for learners, faculty and external partners, you will maintain accurate records, respond to enquiries, support meetings, coordinate rooms and resources, collect feedback and use departmental systems. We are looking for someone who is organised, accurate, a confident communicator and able to manage competing priorities while contributing positively to a busy team. The role is predominantly based within the Medical Education Centre, with occasional attendance at other locations within South Yorkshire. Join us and play an important part in supporting the next generation of doctors. The Medical Education Administrator plays an important role in helping us provide a welcoming, organised and positive educational experience for medical students, resident doctors and other learners. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in delivering a high-quality service and can bring enthusiasm, flexibility and attention to detail to a busy team. You will need to be approachable and professional, with good communication and organisational skills and the confidence to manage changing priorities. Medical Education is a varied and rewarding environment where no two days are quite the same. You will work with learners at different stages of their careers and alongside colleagues who are passionate about supporting education, training and development. In return, you will join a friendly and supportive team where your contribution is valued and where you will have opportunities to develop your knowledge, skills and experience. If you enjoy working as part of a team, building positive working relationships and knowing that your work contributes to the development of our future medical workforce, we would love to hear from you Please see attached the job description and person specification for the full details about the role and the responsibilities

title: Ward Clerk
description: Responsible to the Area Lead Midwife for the provision of efficient, confidential and effective general administration support within Maternity Services. The post-holder will be the initial point of contact for users of the Service, providing a professional approach when dealing with enquiries and to direct enquiries appropriately. Undertake a wide range of administrative and clerical duties in respect of providing Maternity care to the population of Rotherham, ensuring recording and monitoring of patient records are in line with service specifications for the service. Support Maternity staff, ensuring good communication is maintained at all times to provide a high quality service for service users. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries which may be of a confidential nature and deal with visitors, which will require tact and diplomacy. Provide an efficient administrative service covering a wide range of duties. Pull patient notes and ensure these are tracked using the appropriate systems. Input / retrieve information using database as required. Liaise with staff of all disciplines within the multi-agency team, to ensure the smooth running of the service. Maintain good communications with medical staff and others, with regard to patient information Required to purchase equipment as required. Follow Trust and Departmental policies and procedures. Will be required to rotate between labour ward and Wharncliffe Ward depending on departmental needs Use a number of different IT systems to carry out the above including Meditech, SystmOne and Agresso. Maintain an effective filing system and ensure appropriate administrative processes are in place and updated in line with change. Provide clerical support to the Department including, scanning, photocopying and circulation of information. Stock checks and replenishment. Keep accurate and complete records in line with legislation, policies and procedures. Please see attached job description and person specification for full details of the role and responsibilities.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Full Time Medical Receptionist 37hrs or job share for 2 part time Medical Receptions 18.5hrs each Monday - Friday 8.00am - 6.30pm An opportunity has arisen for an experienced receptionist to join our busy team at Greasbrough Medical Centre. We are looking for a motivated receptionist who is well organised and able to work under pressure whilst delivering exceptional customer service. Flexibility in working hours to cover sickness and holidays is essential Answering the telephone, dealing with patient queries, booking appointments, dealing with prescriptions queries, issuing prescriptions, processing hospital post, new patient registrations and any other administration duties which are relevant to the role Greasbrough Medical Centre JOB DESCRIPTION JOB TITLE: MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST REPORTS TO: PRACTICE MANAGER HOURS: 37 hours per week Job summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Job responsibilities: Administration To have a thorough knowledge of all practice procedures To work in accordance of written protocols Scanning/emailing referrals requests Scanning and coding of hospital letters/posts Fax and photocopy as requested Reception Receiving patients, consulting with members of practice team Handing completed repeat prescriptions to patient and checking names and address. Be able to cover all reception position as necessary Appointments Process appointment requests for today/future appointments from patients by telephone and in person. Deal with visits/requests Computer Registrations of new patients computer data entry and medical records Process patients changes of address computer data and medical records (have knowledge of practice area) Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines Telephone Have working knowledge of telephone system during and after hours Cover for telephonist when necessary Other Tasks Clear rooms after surgeries Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm PPA Claims on a monthly basis Any other tasks allocated by managers Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate
